01Pricing

Pay per TB. That's the whole model.

You buy a quota in whole TB at a flat per-TB rate and resize it whenever you like (prorated). The bill never moves on its own: no meters, no overage, no API fees, no request classes, no retrieval surcharges. Every number below comes from one price file; this page is built from it.

Vault

$2/TB/mo

annual · $2.55 monthly · any size

  • Tape-backed archive, restores start in minutes
  • Restore up to 1× your Vault quota every month, free
  • 30-day minimum per object
  • Monthly: $4.99 minimum a month

Standard, most popular

$4.49/TB/mo

annual · $4.99 monthly · any whole-TB quota

  • Automatic tiering built in
  • Egress free to 2× your quota every month, then rate-limited — never billed
  • Hard quota, resize any time, no overage
  • Pin-hot add-on: $3.00/TB/mo keeps chosen data on hot storage

02Free tier

{{.FreeGB}} GB free, no card.

One bucket, one API key, every feature: the real S3 API, multipart, Object Lock, presigned links, version history. Downloads up to {{.FreeEgressGB}} GB a month are free on it too ({{.FreeRatio}}× the free quota), {{.EgressPastShort}}.

03What is charged, and what never is

The quota you buy. Nothing else.

Never charged

  • API calls and requests, of every kind
  • Downloads inside your allowance
  • Vault restores (they draw on the same allowance)
  • Retrieval fees, request classes, minimum object sizes

The egress allowance

One allowance for the account each UTC month: 2× your Standard quota plus 1× your Vault quota.

Past the allowance, downloads are rate-limited to about the pace of one more allowance per month until it resets on the 1st (UTC); they are never billed.

It is one allowance for the whole account: Standard downloads and Vault restores draw on the same number and the same rate limit, and there is no separate restore queue.

What is charged

  • The quota, in whole TB, at the tier's rate for the period you chose
  • Past the allowance nothing is billed: downloads slow down until the 1st (UTC). There is no per-GB rate today
  • A write past the quota is refused with a clear error until you resize; there is no overage

Uploads through the edge

A single upload request is limited to 100 MB: that is Cloudflare's request limit, and a larger one is answered with an HTML 413 before it reaches us. Every S3 tool sends a large file as a multipart upload; keep the part size under 95 MB (64 MB is a good choice). The FAQ has the settings.
